stego_texts: Inside the embassy, an unassuming janitor unexpectedly reveals himself to be a retired spy who uses his knowledge of secret weapon caches hidden within the building’s walls to prevent an imminent attack. He silently disables an armed drone approaching the embassy by hacking into its controls using a hidden device disguised as a mop handle. Realizing the drone was only a distraction, the janitor quickly deciphers a coded message that reveals the true weapons threat is buried beneath the embassy's underground parking garage. He races against time to dismantle the explosive devices hidden beneath a seemingly ordinary car before the attackers can trigger them remotely. Just as the janitor successfully disarms the bombs, he intercepts a final encrypted transmission exposing a mole within the embassy staff coordinating the assault. He discreetly confronts the suspected staff member during a routine safety drill, using subtle interrogations to confirm their guilt without raising alarm. Using a hidden microphone in his janitor's cart, the retired spy transmits proof of the mole's betrayal to embassy security, triggering a coordinated lockdown and capture operation. In the chaos of the lockdown, the janitor spies a suspicious package being delivered through the embassy’s service entrance, prompting him to covertly trail the courier to uncover if it contains more hidden weapons. The janitor discovers the package contains an elaborate robotic weapon disguised as diplomatic cargo, designed to infiltrate the embassy's secured communications room. He stealthily disables the robot by hacking its control module with a modified vacuum cleaner he carries, preventing it from compromising the embassy’s communication systems. As the janitor secures the communications room, he uncovers a secret passage leading to an underground weapons cache unknown even to the embassy’s top officials. Inside the secret underground chamber, the janitor discovers a detailed blueprint linking the cache to a covert network of international arms dealers operating under diplomatic immunity. Using his spy training, the janitor sends the blueprint to a trusted intelligence contact while setting traps throughout the passage to delay any intruders trying to recover the weapons cache. As the janitor prepares to exit the chamber, he hears footsteps and narrowly avoids detection by hiding inside a concealed compartment built into the wall. The footsteps belong to a high-ranking embassy official who, shocked to find the janitor missing and the hidden passage exposed, tries to secretly destroy the weapons cache to cover up their involvement.

The spy quickly switches to a backup device hidden in a diplomatic briefcase and continues recording without raising further suspicion. Realizing the lockdown could escalate tensions, the spy uses the AI to send a covert message to the embassy's loyal security team, alerting them to the situation and requesting immediate backup. The loyal security team arrives just in time, swiftly apprehending the corrupt officials while the spy uses the untraceable communication device to expose the scandal worldwide. In the aftermath, the spy anonymously leaves the embassy, knowing the true battle was not just against corruption but the shadowy forces orchestrating it from afar. As the spy disappears into the night, the AI security system quietly begins analyzing incoming embassy communications for any signs of retaliation from the shadowy forces.
